title: feat(core,history,react,vue): add canUndo/canRedo API, undo grouping, clearHistory, and framework bindings

commits.message:
feat(core,history): add canUndo/canRedo API and undo grouping

Add canUndo() and canRedo() methods to EditorAPI so host UIs can query
the undo/redo stack state for toolbar button enablement.

Add historyChange event to EditorEventMap — emits { canUndo, canRedo }
on every history state transition, with deduplication for unchanged states.

Enhance createHistoryPlugin() with HistoryPluginOptions (newGroupDelay,
minDepth) for configurable undo grouping — replaces the bare history()
call with explicit configuration while preserving backward compatibility.

OpenSpec: add-history-state-api

fix(core): suppress historyChange on silent document loads

Previously setDocument({ silent: true }) (file-open from disk) would
emit historyChange events despite the silent flag. Silent transactions
should not trigger any user-facing UI events.

Also adds 7 edge-case tests:
- Silent load suppression
- undo() / redo() on empty stack returns false, no events
- replaceSelection triggers historyChange
- No history plugin installed → no events fire
- Multi-step undo tracking with fake timers

feat(history,react,vue): add clearHistory, expose canUndo/canRedo in bindings

clearHistory via editor.runCommand(history.clear):
- Uses two-stage Compartment reconfigure (empty then history) to
  reset CodeMirror's singleton historyField_ StateField.
- Emits historyChange({ canUndo: false, canRedo: false }) on clear.
- Guarded against IME composition.

React useEditor now returns reactive canUndo / canRedo:
- Subscribes to historyChange event, cleans up on unmount.
- Types updated (UseEditorResult).

Vue useEditor now returns reactive canUndo / canRedo:
- Same pattern with ref() and historyChange subscription.

Added @codemirror/state dependency to plugin-history for Compartment.

test(history): add edge-case tests for clearHistory

Cover undo-after-clear, fresh-edit-after-clear, idempotent double-clear,
and Ctrl+Z after clear scenarios. All 14 plugin-history tests pass.
